fusions.name: Pinpoint Prod
fusions.desc: Sends a narrow bolt that deals 9 damage. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Seam Strike
fusions.desc: A charging thrust that deals 30 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at its maximum range of 6 tiles, and deals 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health on top.

fusions.name: Locked On
fusions.desc: Increases your critical chance by 20% for 12 seconds. Pulls up to 3 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Gap Found
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
